spans.s: yāpanaka (nt.? = Skt. yāpana; -ka svārthe), prob. either curing (sc. diseases), or sustenance, (furnishing) livelihood (to others): ˚ka-saṃpannāḥ, said of Bodhisattvas, Mv 〔ii.289.9〕; both these mgs. recorded for Skt. yāpana; Senart vitalité.

yāpanīya, adj. or subst. nt. (to Skt. yāpana plus īya; = Pali id., Vin. 〔i.59.10〕, with khamanīya), livable, comfortable: kaccit te bhagavan kṣamaṇīyaṃ kaccid yāpanīyaṃ kaccid dhātavaḥ pratikurvanti SP 〔429.4〕, I hope, Lord, things are tolerable and comfortable for you, and that your bodily elements are working all right?; ˚yatara, compv., Divy 〔110.2〕, see s.v. kṣemaṇīya.
